connector.name: S3 by pulsemcp.com
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for AWS S3 with fine-grained tool control and S3-compatible endpoint support.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package s3-aws-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.pulsemcp. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
env.description: AWS access key ID for authentication.

env.name: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
env.description: AWS secret access key for authentication.

env.name: AWS_ENDPOINT_URL
env.description: Custom S3 endpoint URL for MinIO or S3-compatible services.

env.name: S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE
env.description: Use path-style addressing instead of virtual-hosted-style.

env.name: S3_BUCKET
env.description: Constrain all operations to a single bucket.

env.name: S3_ENABLED_TOOLGROUPS
env.description: Comma-separated tool groups: readonly or readwrite.

env.name: SKIP_HEALTH_CHECKS
env.description: Skip AWS credential validation health checks at startup.
